programmes.d: When a Vietnam veteran is hired by a TV reporter to return to where he was tortured as a P.O.W., the fuse is lit for vengeance.
A police officer travels to Vietnam to extradite a suspect and discovers a murderer who has been targeting tourists for years.

programmes.d: The story of a warrior named Ogami Itto and his son comes full circle.
When a cop murders and rapes a woman, he puts the blame on a local man who must prove his innocence.
Two schools of fighting vie for control of a village in northern Manchuria.
A 250-foot monster wrecks London landmarks to free her baby, found by seamen (Bill Travers, William Sylvester) and put in a circus.
